rule: Method: `Type#member`. Nested types are dotted: `Outer.Inner#m`. | **Zig**: file-qualified: `file.Struct#fn`, `file.fn`; `@import` bindings make `std.x.y` medium.
notes: call_type convention used throughout this corpus: a callee that is a member of a type (`T#m`) or a receiver-qualified guess (`recv.m`, `.m`) is `method`; a free function (`file.f`, `std.x.f`) is `direct`. All files sit directly under src/, so the file qualifier is the basename (`app`, `util`). Inner is declared inside Outer → `app.Outer.Inner#m`. Inside Outer, the bare type name `Inner` resolves lexically to Outer.Inner; the locals `i` are typed by their declarations (decision A).
